meta.name: tfx-ship
meta.description: triflux 전용 릴리즈 자동화. **GitHub Actions(release.yml dispatch / npm-publish.yml) 기반 CI 릴리즈가 기본 경로 — npm publish 는 OIDC Trusted Publishing 으로 CI 가 수행하므로 로컬 npm login 불필요.** scripts/release/* 래퍼 + AskUserQuestion 기반 버전 선택 + CHANGELOG 편집 게이트 + Co-Authored-By/AI trailer 금지 강제. 'ship', '배포', '릴리즈', 'release', 'tfx-ship', 'publish' 같은 요청에 반드시 사용.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键触发发布流程,自动完成版本选择与日志更新
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要经常为 npm 包发布新版本并希望流程自动化
copy.tagline_en: Trigger automated releases with version selection and changelog updates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to publish npm packages frequently and want the process automated

howto.what: 装上后,针对 triflux 项目,你说要发布新版本时,Claude 会先询问版本号,再自动同步版本文件、生成 CHANGELOG、跑测试、打标签推送,触发 CI 发布到 GitHub、npm 和 Claude 市场,最后核验结果。提交信息会强制去掉 AI 署名。
howto.when: 当你说出“ship”“release”“publish”等发布类关键词,或要求发布新版本、部署时触发;也可带版本号或 --skip-tests 等标志。

say.text: 用 release 发一个 patch 版本
say.note: 询问确认后自动走发布流程
对应 --no-publish,不触发 CI 发布

say.text: 先 dry-run 看看发布要做什么

howto.what_en: On release requests, Claude asks for a version, syncs version files, drafts CHANGELOG, runs tests, tags/pushes to trigger CI (GitHub/npm/marketplace), then verifies. Commit messages must omit AI co-author trailers.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'ship', 'release', 'publish' or ask to release/deploy a new version. You can also pass a version or flags like --skip-tests.

say_en.note: Asks for confirmation then runs the flow.

say_en.text: Publish 2.0.0 but don't push the tag.
